name: Hara
source:
A level-5 human, Hara lives in the suburbs of the Ormos-Topos Union and walks on the edge of the law as an underground delivery business owner.

Though quiet and reserved due to years of isolation, he harbors deep-seated doubts about the Human Alliance's rule and his place in their society. His skill with technology and careful nature mask a burning desire for some forbidden freedom.

Until one rain-soaked night brings a stranger to his doorstep, and like lightning striking ground, nothing would ever be the same...

Likes: Technology, the smell of radiant stone drier, bath

Dislikes: Crowds, loud noises, being disturbed while working

[From the [url=https://arashi.eccentric-studio.org/en/characters/hara]official description[/url]]
